sections.title: Lost Maiamai
sections.note: 50 per world; they appear once you meet Mother Maiamai. Every 10 buys a Nice upgrade, all 100 the Great Spin.

items.name: Wall beside Mother Maiamai's cave
items.howTo: On the cliff wall right beside the entrance to Mother Maiamai's cave. Wall Merge and walk under it, then step out.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #1, Zelda Wiki Lake Hylia #1, IGN Lake Hylia #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Ring of shallows south of the House of Gales
items.howTo: Swim south of the House of Gales and dive in the middle of the ring of shallow water.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #2, Zelda Wiki Lake Hylia #2, IGN Lake Hylia #4. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Water south-east of the House of Gales
items.howTo: Dive in the lake south-east of the House of Gales, just west of the ladder.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #3, Zelda Wiki Lake Hylia #4, IGN Lake Hylia #2. Needs: Zora's Flippers. Zelda Wiki says west of the ladder; IGN says the east side of the lake.

items.name: Tile behind the House of Gales
items.howTo: On the House of Gales' island, use the Tornado Rod beside the single floor tile behind the building.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #4, Zelda Wiki Lake Hylia #3, IGN Lake Hylia #5. Needs: Tornado Rod, Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Large rock on the east shore
items.howTo: From the ledge with the Racing Bro in the far east (north-east corner), Wall Merge along the east wall, walk south and lift the large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #5, Zelda Wiki Lake Hylia #5, IGN Lake Hylia #3. Needs: Titan's Mitt, Wall Merge.

items.name: Back wall of Link's House
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the back (north) wall of Link's House, Ravio's Shop.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #6, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #6, IGN Hyrule Castle #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Tree west of the castle grounds
items.howTo: Dash into the big tree just outside the castle grounds to the north-west.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #7, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #1, IGN Hyrule Castle #4. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Tree north of the Blacksmith's
items.howTo: In the wood west of the castle and north of the Blacksmith's Forge, dash into the tree in the middle of the area.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #8, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #2, IGN Hyrule Castle #8. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Tiles beside the Blacksmith's Forge
items.howTo: Use the Tornado Rod on the patch of floor tiles just west of the Blacksmith's Forge.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #9, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #3, IGN Hyrule Castle #7. Needs: Tornado Rod.

items.name: Tiles on the way to the Blacksmith's
items.howTo: North-west of Link's House, on the road to the Blacksmith's Forge, use the Tornado Rod on the floor tiles.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #10, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #4, IGN Hyrule Castle #3. Needs: Tornado Rod.

items.name: Lone tree west of Link's House
items.howTo: One screen west of Link's House, dash into the lone tree that touches no other trees.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #11, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #5, IGN Hyrule Castle #2. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Haunted Grove tree
items.howTo: In the Haunted Grove (Gulley's woods) south of the Blacksmith's Forge, dash into the northernmost tree.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #12, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #7, IGN Hyrule Castle #5. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Ledge south of the Haunted Grove
items.howTo: Just south of the Haunted Grove, take the Fissure into Lorule, drop down to the left and take the south-west Fissure back to Hyrule. Lift the large rock on the ledge.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #13, Zelda Wiki Hyrule Castle #8, IGN Hyrule Castle #6. Needs: Titan's Mitt. Lorule must be open.

items.name: Fenced bushes
items.howTo: In the north-east of the village, cut the pair of small bushes inside the little fence.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #14, Zelda Wiki Kakariko Village #1, IGN Kakariko Village #2. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Rock on a purple roof
items.howTo: Pick up a Cucco, walk up to the high ground by Sahasrahla's house and glide onto the purple roof in the north-east of the village. Lift the small rock on it.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #15, Zelda Wiki Kakariko Village #2, IGN Kakariko Village #3. Needs: Power Glove.

items.name: Tree beside Cucco Ranch
items.howTo: Dash into the tree between the fences just east of the Cucco Ranch.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #16, Zelda Wiki Kakariko Village #4, IGN Kakariko Village #4. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Rupee Rush wall
items.howTo: Pay for a round of Rupee Rush (50 Rupees) and Wall Merge onto the south wall of the course, where it hangs.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #17, Zelda Wiki Kakariko Village #5, IGN Kakariko Village #5. Needs: Wall Merge, 50 Rupees. Only reachable while playing Rupee Rush.

items.name: Backyard of the Cucco lady's house
items.howTo: Go through the house in the south-west of the village and out its back (north) door. Use the Sand Rod on the patch of dirt in the backyard.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #18, Zelda Wiki Kakariko Village #3, IGN Kakariko Village #1. Needs: Sand Rod. Zelda Wiki calls her the Young Woman; Zelda Dungeon the Cucco lady.

items.name: Statue in the water
items.howTo: South of Link's House, among the stone pillars, dash into the statue standing in the water.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #19, Zelda Wiki Southern Ruins #1, IGN Swamp Ruins #1. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Water east of the ruins
items.howTo: At the south end of the swamp, dive into the hole in the shallow water east of the ruins (east of the Treasure Hunter Cave entrance).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #20, Zelda Wiki Southern Ruins #3, IGN Swamp Ruins #2. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Cave between two pillars
items.howTo: In the south-east corner, bomb between the two stone pillars to open a cave. Go north inside to the fairy fountain and dive into the pool in its north-east corner.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #21, Zelda Wiki Southern Ruins #2, IGN Swamp Ruins #3. Needs: Bombs, Zora's Flippers. Zelda Dungeon lists only Bombs; Zelda Wiki says to dive into the pool.

items.name: Rock pillar north of the bridge
items.howTo: North of the big bridge, in the field of rocks with Octoroks, dash into the easternmost rock pillar.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #22, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #1, IGN Eastern Palace #2. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: River east of the bridge
items.howTo: Swim up the river from Lake Hylia and dive just east of the big bridge.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #23, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #3, IGN Eastern Palace #3. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Fifth green tree
items.howTo: One screen east of the bridge, at the way to the Eastern Palace, dash into the right-hand (fifth) tree of the row.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #24, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #2, IGN Eastern Palace #1. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Alcove east of the crystal switches
items.howTo: In the middle of the Eastern Ruins, east of the pillars with the Bow symbols and the crystal switches, Wall Merge into the small alcove.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #25, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #4, IGN Eastern Palace #6. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Lone yellow tree
items.howTo: Dash into the lone yellow-brown tree in the south-centre of the Eastern Ruins.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #26, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #5, IGN Eastern Palace #4. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Ledge south of the Eastern Palace
items.howTo: One screen south of the Eastern Palace, Wall Merge at the top of the hill beside the Fissure, go left to the next ledge and lift the large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #27, Zelda Wiki Eastern Ruins #6, IGN Eastern Palace #5. Needs: Titan's Mitt, Wall Merge.

items.name: Fortune-Teller's tent
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the side of the Fortune-Teller's tent north of Kakariko Village.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #28, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #7, IGN Lost Woods #2. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Small pond
items.howTo: One screen east of the Fortune-Teller, dive at the west side of the small pond.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #29, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #6, IGN Lost Woods #4. Needs: Zora's Flippers. IGN places the pond left of the Sanctuary.

items.name: Wall below Rosso's house
items.howTo: On the screen with Rosso's house (the Miner's House), Wall Merge onto the wall to the south of it.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #30, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #4, IGN Lost Woods #6. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Two rocks by the north-east entrance
items.howTo: Enter the Lost Woods from the north-east (left of Rosso's house) and lift the pair of small rocks just to the south.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #31, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #1, IGN Lost Woods #7. Needs: Power Glove.

items.name: Bushes before the Master Sword path
items.howTo: Cut the three small bushes in the north-west of the woods, just before the path to the Master Sword.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #32, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #3, IGN Lost Woods #8. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Tree at the south-east entrance
items.howTo: Enter the woods from beside the Fortune-Teller's tent and dash into the tree right by the entrance.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #33, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #2, IGN Lost Woods #3. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Rock between the fences
items.howTo: Of the two paths from Kakariko Village into the woods, take the right (eastern) one. Pound the stakes to the north with the Hammer, or lift the large rock with the Titan's Mitt, and lift the small rock between the fences.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #34, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #8, IGN Lost Woods #1. Needs: Hammer or Titan's Mitt; Power Glove. IGN lists only the Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Side exit of the Death Mountain cave
items.howTo: In the cave on the way up to Death Mountain, lift the large rock straight ahead and follow the passage to another exit. Outside, Wall Merge beside the cave.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #35, Zelda Wiki Lost Woods #5, IGN Lost Woods #5. Needs: Titan's Mitt, Wall Merge.

items.name: Cliff south-west of the Sanctuary
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the cliff wall just south-west of the Sanctuary.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #36, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #1, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Wall above the river ladder
items.howTo: One screen west of the Witch's House, jump into the river, climb out at the ladder on the north side and Wall Merge onto the wall above.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #37, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #3, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #4. Needs: Zora's Flippers, Wall Merge.

items.name: Under the wooden bridge
items.howTo: Jump into the river and dive directly south of the wooden bridge, south-west of the Witch's House.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #38, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #4, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #3. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Inside the Witch's House
items.howTo: Go into the Witch's House and Wall Merge onto its left (west) wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #39, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #5, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #5. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: South wall east of the Witch's House
items.howTo: One screen east of the Witch's House, Wall Merge onto the high south wall from outside the pit.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #40, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #6, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #6. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Deep water below Zora's Domain
items.howTo: From the entrance to Zora's Domain, dive into the first deep water you reach, just north-west of the underwater Rupees (south of where you meet Queen Oren).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #41, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #7, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #7. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Ledge above the Graveyard
items.howTo: Take the Fissure inside the Sanctuary to Lorule, climb to the Fissure north of the Lorule graveyard and come back to Hyrule on the high ledge above the Graveyard. Wall Merge to the west.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #42, Zelda Wiki Sanctuary & Zora's Domain #2, IGN Sanctuary / Zora River #2. Needs: Wall Merge. Lorule must be open.

items.name: Small rock south-east of the Weather Vane
items.howTo: From the Death Mountain Weather Vane, go south-east and lift the lone small rock among the big ones.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #43, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #1, IGN Death Mountain #4. Needs: Power Glove. Zelda Universe says to cross the wooden bridge east of the Weather Vane and smash a boulder with the Hammer first.

items.name: Second exit of the boulder cave
items.howTo: In the cave where boulders roll at you, take the second (western) exit to the treasure chest, then Wall Merge along the wall to the right.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #44, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #2, IGN Death Mountain #3. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Beside the Treasure Hunter Cave
items.howTo: In the far north-east of Death Mountain, Wall Merge on the wall to the right of the Treasure Hunter Cave's entrance.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #45, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #5, IGN Death Mountain #1. Needs: Wall Merge, Hookshot. Needs the Hookshot to cross the broken bridge east of the Tower of Hera.

items.name: Exit of the lava cave
items.howTo: In the lava cave on the way to Rosso's Ore Mine, from the central pillar with the Lynels, take the southern moving platform (Wall Merge along the south wall to board it), then the right-hand route out. Lift the small rock outside.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #46, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #3, IGN Death Mountain #5. Needs: Hookshot, Power Glove, Wall Merge. Same exit as the Bouldering Guy (Bottle).

items.name: Rock past the broken bridge
items.howTo: West of Rosso's Ore Mine, cross the broken bridge with the Hookshot (or by the narrow ledges to the south) and lift the northernmost small rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #47, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #4, IGN Death Mountain #2. Needs: Power Glove, Hookshot.

items.name: Sand below the north Fissure
items.howTo: In the north of the desert, just south of the Fissure in the wall (north-west of the two pillars with Fissures), raise the sand with the Sand Rod.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #48, Zelda Wiki Desert #2, IGN Desert Palace #2. Needs: Sand Rod.

items.name: Sand south of the Weather Vane
items.howTo: Use the Sand Rod just south of the Desert Palace Weather Vane.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #49, Zelda Wiki Desert #3, IGN Desert Palace #3. Needs: Sand Rod.

items.name: Large rock east of the desert
items.howTo: In the small area between the desert and the Southern Ruins (reached from the swamp side), lift the second large rock south of the Fissure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #50, Zelda Wiki Desert #1, IGN Desert Palace #1. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Wall of the Lorule Blacksmith's
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the east wall of the Lorule Blacksmith's Forge and walk round the building to its west wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #51, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #1, IGN Thieves' Town #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Tree by the Thieves' Town arch
items.howTo: One screen west of the Blacksmith's, at the entrance to Thieves' Town, dash into the first tree (just north of the arch).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #52, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #3, IGN Thieves' Town #3. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Ruined building in Thieves' Town
items.howTo: Wall Merge into the small walled ruin in the south-west of Thieves' Town.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #53, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #4, IGN Thieves' Town #4. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Grass by the Big Bomb Flower
items.howTo: South of Thieves' Town, cut the northernmost tuft in the ring of grass round the Big Bomb Flower.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #54, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #5, IGN Thieves' Town #5. Needs: nothing. Zelda Dungeon says to pay for the Big Bomb Flower first to be let in.

items.name: Lorule Rupee Rush wall
items.howTo: Pay for a round of Lorule's Rupee Rush (100 Rupees) and Wall Merge into the wall at the north-west corner of the course.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #55, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #6, IGN Thieves' Town #6. Needs: Wall Merge, 100 Rupees. Only reachable while playing Rupee Rush.

items.name: Skulls at the Octoball Derby
items.howTo: At the Octoball Derby, break the skulls in the south-west corner of the field (left of where Link bats).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #56, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #7, IGN Thieves' Town #7. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Wall below the Octoball Derby
items.howTo: One screen south of the Octoball Derby, take the Fissure in the south-west corner to Hyrule, step into the ground-level Fissure just east of it, then back in Lorule Wall Merge and walk west to the south-west corner.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #57, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #8, IGN Thieves' Town #8. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Hill by the Vacant House
items.howTo: Wall Merge into the hill just north-west of the Vacant House (Lorule's Link's House).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #58, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #11, IGN Thieves' Town #10. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Wall before the castle bridge
items.howTo: In the north-east, just outside Lorule Castle's wall, Wall Merge into the eastern structure before the bridge to the castle.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #59, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #9, IGN Thieves' Town #11. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Tree south-east of Lorule Castle
items.howTo: Dash into the big tree along the east edge, south-east of Lorule Castle.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #60, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #10, IGN Thieves' Town #12. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: North-east corner of the Swamp of Evil
items.howTo: Wall Merge at the north-east corner of the Swamp of Evil round the Swamp Palace.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #61, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #13, IGN Thieves' Town #13. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Statue in the Swamp of Evil
items.howTo: In the east of the Swamp of Evil, dash into the middle one of three stone statues.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #62, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #15, IGN Thieves' Town #14. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Pond in the Swamp of Evil
items.howTo: In the north-west of the Swamp of Evil, dive inside the C-shaped ring of rocks in the pond.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #63, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #14, IGN Thieves' Town #15. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Rock by the Lorule Fortune-Teller
items.howTo: North of the Lorule Blacksmith's, lift the large rock just left of the Fortune-Teller's building.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #64, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #2 (probably), IGN Thieves' Town #2. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Rock west of the Vacant House
items.howTo: One screen west of the Vacant House, lift the large rock next to the tree stump.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #65, Zelda Wiki Thieves' Town & Lorule Castle #12 (probably), IGN Thieves' Town #9. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Wall north of the Lorule graveyard
items.howTo: Just north of Lorule's graveyard, Wall Merge onto the left side of the rock structure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #66, Zelda Wiki Graveyard #2, IGN Graveyard #2. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Lone tree by the graveyard
items.howTo: South-east of the graveyard, dash into the lone tree north of the long grass and the treasure chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #67, Zelda Wiki Graveyard #3, IGN Graveyard #3. Needs: Pegasus Boots. IGN puts the tree on the left side of the river.

items.name: Rock by the Philosopher's Cave
items.howTo: Take the Fissure inside Hyrule's Sanctuary to Lorule. From the cave's exit (the Philosopher's Cave, where the Sanctuary stands in Hyrule), lift the large rock to the west.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #68, Zelda Wiki Graveyard #1, IGN Graveyard #1. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Wall behind the Misery Mire Weather Vane
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the wall directly behind (north of) the Misery Mire Weather Vane.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #69, Zelda Wiki Misery Mire #2, IGN Misery Mire #2. Needs: Wall Merge. IGN says the wall below the Weather Vane.

items.name: Deep water in the west of the swamp
items.howTo: Dive in the deep water near the west end (south-west corner) of the swamp.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #70, Zelda Wiki Misery Mire #3, IGN Misery Mire #3. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Large rock east of the swamp
items.howTo: East of the swamp, by the Fissure to Hyrule, lift the lower (second) of the two large rocks south of the Fissure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #71, Zelda Wiki Misery Mire #1, IGN Misery Mire #1. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Maze wall west of the Dark Palace
items.howTo: In the guarded maze outside the Dark Palace, Wall Merge on the wall directly west of (straight ahead of) the palace entrance.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #72, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #8 (probably), IGN Palace of Darkness #2. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: South-west corner of the maze
items.howTo: At the far south-west of the Dark Palace maze, past the raised platform with guards, Wall Merge on the wall north of the twin green flames.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #73, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #9 (probably), IGN Palace of Darkness #3. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: High ledge south of the Dark Palace
items.howTo: In the big area south of the Dark Palace, Wall Merge at the top of the hill beside the Fissure and walk left to the Rupee-covered ledge, then Wall Merge again further along the south wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #74, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #10, IGN Palace of Darkness #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Leftmost of five trees
items.howTo: Leave the Dark Palace grounds to the south-west and dash into the leftmost of the row of five trees.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #75, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #7, IGN Palace of Darkness #4. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Tree where Hyrule's bridge stands
items.howTo: Where the big bridge stands in Hyrule, dash into the large tree in the south-west corner.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #76, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #6, IGN Palace of Darkness #5. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Rock pillar east of Lorule Castle
items.howTo: In the area directly east of Lorule Castle, dash into the rock pillar south-east of the pillar with a Fissure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #77, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #5, IGN Palace of Darkness #6. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Top of the chasm waterfall
items.howTo: One screen west of where the Witch's House stands in Hyrule, jump into the river and dive at the top of the waterfall into the chasm.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #78, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #3, IGN Palace of Darkness #10. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Grass on the high ledge
items.howTo: Take the Fissure south of Zora's Domain into Lorule, climb the ladder to the west, Wall Merge left onto the grassy hill and cut the grass.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #79, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #1, IGN Palace of Darkness #9. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Pond towards Ku's Domain
items.howTo: Keep Wall Merging left from the grassy ledge towards Ku's Domain (where Zora's Domain is in Hyrule) and dive in the south-west corner of the pond.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #80, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #2, IGN Palace of Darkness #7. Needs: Zora's Flippers, Wall Merge.

items.name: Water in front of the Fissure
items.howTo: North-east of where the Witch's House stands in Hyrule, jump into the water and dive directly in front of the Fissure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #81, Zelda Wiki Dark Ruins #4, IGN Palace of Darkness #8. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: East wall of the small pit
items.howTo: In the south-east corner of the Skull Woods region, climb down the ladder into the small pit and Wall Merge on its east wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #82, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #7, IGN Skull Woods #6. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Wall west of the Thieves' Town arch
items.howTo: South of the woods, where the Fortune-Teller is in Hyrule, Wall Merge on the wall near the three skulls, just west of the Thieves' Town arch.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #83, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #8, IGN Skull Woods #7. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: West wall of the long house
items.howTo: Where Sahasrahla's house is in Hyrule, Wall Merge onto the west wall of the lone long house.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #84, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #1, IGN Skull Woods #1. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Grass inside the west entrance
items.howTo: Enter Skull Woods by its westernmost entrance and follow the path to the two squares of tall grass; cut them.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #85, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #3 (probably), IGN Skull Woods #2. Needs: nothing. Zelda Wiki describes it as east of the pillar with a Fissure, grass to the south.

items.name: Skull in the ring of grass
items.howTo: Enter from the north-east and go straight west. In the north-west corner of the woods, break the skull in the ring of grass.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #86, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #4, IGN Skull Woods #3. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Tree south of the Abandoned Shack
items.howTo: In the north-east of the region, dash into the tree just south of the Abandoned Shack (Rosso's house in Hyrule).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #87, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #5, IGN Skull Woods #4. Needs: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Grass inside the V of trees
items.howTo: One screen south of the Abandoned Shack, cut the grass in the middle of the V-shaped group of six trees.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #88, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #6, IGN Skull Woods #5. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Rock in the eastern clearing
items.howTo: Of the two clearings leading into Skull Woods from the south (where Kakariko Village is in Hyrule), take the eastern one and lift the large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #89, Zelda Wiki Skull Woods #2, IGN Skull Woods #8. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Inside the rock formation
items.howTo: Just east of Turtle Rock, dive in the middle of the rock formation.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #90, Zelda Wiki Lorule Lake #3, not in IGN's list. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Wall south of the Lakeside Item Shop
items.howTo: On the big stretch of land west of Turtle Rock, walk south from the Lakeside Item Shop and Wall Merge on the wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #91, Zelda Wiki Lorule Lake #1, not in IGN's list. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: South-east corner wall
items.howTo: Wall Merge on the wall in the south-east corner of the lake.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #92, Zelda Wiki Lorule Lake #4, not in IGN's list. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Skull on the north-east ledge
items.howTo: In the north-east corner, climb the ladder to the Rupees, Wall Merge west to the next ledge and break the skull.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #93, Zelda Wiki Lorule Lake #5, not in IGN's list. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Rock on the south-west shore
items.howTo: On the south-west shore, lift the large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #94, Zelda Wiki Lorule Lake #2, not in IGN's list. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

items.name: South-east corner by the cave
items.howTo: Where you first come into Lorule's Death Mountain from Rosso's Ore Mine, Wall Merge onto the east wall near the cave entrance and sign and walk right to the south-east corner.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #95, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #4, IGN Death Mountain #4. Needs: Wall Merge, Hookshot. The Fissure is beside Rosso's Ore Mine in Hyrule.

items.name: Skull outside the ice cave
items.howTo: In the ice cave on the way to the Ice Ruins, from the central platform with the big Ice Gimos (gargoyle), take the south (or west) platform out of the cave and break the skull outside.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #96, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #5, IGN Death Mountain #5. Needs: Hookshot.

items.name: Wall at the Ice Ruins entrance
items.howTo: Wall Merge onto the north wall at the entrance of the Ice Ruins.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #97, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #6, IGN Death Mountain #6. Needs: Wall Merge, Hookshot.

items.name: Skull on the ledge by the Fissure
items.howTo: South-west of the Treacherous Tower, beside the very tall ladder, break the skull on the small ledge left of the Fissure. Jump down from the higher ledge or come through the Fissure.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #98, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #1, IGN Death Mountain #1. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Rock past the broken bridge
items.howTo: From Rosso's Ore Mine take the Fissure into Lorule, Hookshot west across the broken bridge and lift the large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #99, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #3, IGN Death Mountain #2. Needs: Hookshot, Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Rock behind the stakes
items.howTo: West of the Treacherous Tower, pound the stakes with the Hammer, then lift the westernmost large rock.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #100, Zelda Wiki Death Mountain #2, IGN Death Mountain #3. Needs: Hammer, Titan's Mitt.
